subject: ela
intro: Read and pick the meaning of the word.

items.prompt:
Read.

The puppy was tiny. It fit in one hand.

What does 'tiny' mean?
A) Very small
B) Very big
C) Very loud

steps: It fit in one hand. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The soup was hot. It burned my tongue.

What does 'hot' mean?
A) Cold
B) Very warm
C) Sweet

Read.

The turtle was slow.

What does 'slow' mean?
A) Fast
B) Not fast
C) Big

steps: Slow means not fast. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The cave was dark, so we used a light.

What does 'dark' mean?
A) Bright
B) No light
C) Warm

steps: They needed a light. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The box was heavy. No one could lift it.

What does 'heavy' mean?
A) Light
B) Hard to lift
C) Soft

steps: No one could lift it. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The lemon was sour and made me pucker.

What does 'sour' mean?
A) Sweet
B) Tart
C) Hot

steps: Made me pucker. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The old man was wise. He always knew the right thing to do.

What does 'wise' mean?
A) Silly
B) Smart and knowing
C) Young

steps: He knew the right thing. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The crowd was enormous. People filled the whole park.

What does 'enormous' mean?
A) Tiny
B) Very big
C) Quiet

steps: Filled the whole park. Key is B.
